theme.name: Gilded Noir
theme.author: Catto Learning
theme.description: Luxury black, gold, silver and ivory full Catto Learning application skin based on Gilded Noir 1.1.2, with an abacus/scales/parchment home hero, sphere footer, section imagery, core-owned navigation contracts, and complete page-family coverage. 2.0.1 keeps its own engraved canvas and its own footer, and carries the signed-in identity as a chip in the navigation bar rather than as a band in the page body.
